## Summary

What changed?

## Type

- [ ] Add skill or resource
- [ ] Update existing entry
- [ ] Remove or archive entry
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling or workflow

## Quality Check

- [ ] The resource solves a clear reusable task.
- [ ] The resource has public docs or source code.
- [ ] Installation or usage notes are included.
- [ ] Platform, category, tags, maturity, and license are included.
- [ ] Safety notes are included when tools, credentials, files, browsers, APIs, databases, or external communication are involved.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] `npm run generate` has been run if data changed.

## Notes

Known limitations, safety concerns, or follow-up work.
